dialogues.speaker: Alcina
dialogues.text: If you hadn't told me, I would never have known that he was in this line before.

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: Heh. I mean, it's not completely unreasonable. Doing dirty business doesn't mean you don't accumulate experience, right?

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: Now he's changed jobs to some sort of financial consultant, mentioning a few "investment trends" to the Boss every so often for some easy Mora. Pretty sweet deal.

dialogues.speaker: Alcina
dialogues.text: Agreed. Speaking of which, I'm reminded of some kid who wasn't able to join the Spina di Rosula.

dialogues.speaker: Alcina
dialogues.text: Had a silver tongue, he did, but no real ability. Lately, I've heard that he's gotten mixed up in another faction, and he's been walking with a real swagger since.

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: Ooh, that's dangerous behavior, ignoring the Palais Mermonia like that — reckon he'll be "invited" to sing at the opera soon enough.

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: ...Hi, do you need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: Haha... Guess I must look pretty bad, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: There are too many things to do in town these days which require strenuous labor. I'm a little beat, so I'm just taking a rest.

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: I used to have someone to talk to when taking a break, but now... Forget it, best not to think about that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm okay. You take care of yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: Eh, fine.

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: Hello. Would you like to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure. Anything you want to talk about?

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: Hmm... I've been so caught up with the town's reconstruction work that I've been blind and deaf to everything else...

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: But now that I'm free, I find myself disinterested in gossip and the like.

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: I should find something to do and keep myself busy. It's the only way to keep my thoughts from running wild.

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: It would be nice to sail across the ocean to somewhere else or get some other new hobby.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: It's fine, go ahead.
